theorems.name: Submission.mcs_firstVariation_add
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (X Y : Euclid P → Euclid P), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier) → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → HasCompactSupport Y → tsupport Y ⊆ U → R.firstVariation (X + Y) = R.firstVariation X + R.firstVariation Y
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
